scope: Canonical reinspection and signer nonce reservation in the existing x402 service; no public deployment

windows.fixtures: Disposable Anvil, actual EIP3009 token fixture and pinned unchanged upstream Permit2/proxy, PGlite and disk reopen; generated local accounts only

newCases: Actual successful transaction reorg: cached success is withdrawn, an old operator nonce cannot serve another authorization, original raw/hash/nonce recover across disk restart
Confirmation depth rolls back with the original receipt retained: return pending without rebroadcast, then recover after mining the required depth
Finalized RPC outage fails closed without repeating cached resource execution; an old accepted settlement is inspected after payer authorization expiry
Current recipient pins are checked for finalized nonzero and chainless zero-charge journals
Another unresolved authorization prevents orphaned terminal downgrade or broadcast
Concurrent new reservation waits for terminal reorg inspection under the shared database lock
Forged success in a prepared journal is rejected before an RPC fallback
independentReview: Read-only second-agent review confirmed nonce reservation, prepared/terminal serialization, configuration checks and no cached-success fallback; no remaining actionable service finding

corrections: An existing injected broadcast callback queried the same single-connection PGlite while reconciliation held its transaction, causing a fixture deadlock. The callback now records the actual signed bytes and the test checks the durable journal after the dropped response and reopens disk before retry.

The new concurrency fixture created its second authorization after the later branch, then reverted time. Both authorizations now originate before the branch. Production authorization-time checks were unchanged.

limitations: This is a focused suite, not a new complete repository regression
No public Robinhood transaction, USDG capability enablement or paid-provider call
Every nonzero finality observation holds the global signer reservation lock across chain inspection and any original-byte send
Public-chain reorganization after a response remains possible; reinspection does not guarantee irreversible finality
The existing direct-token gateway and the separately implemented native Vault ingress retain separate capability and deployment boundaries
